intro.title: A Legacy of Perfection
intro.description: Each pearl of Maison Rocheval caviar is selected by hand, following ancestral methods. The size, texture, and flavor profile are strictly evaluated to meet Michelin-starred standards.

about.title: The Art of Maturation
about.description: From our pure waters to your table, our caviar undergoes a rigorous aging process. Time and temperature are balanced perfectly to release layers of walnut, seaweed, and butter notes.

hero.title: Our Heritage
hero.description: The pursuit of the perfect pearl. An uncompromising journey of taste.

history.title: Born from Pure Waters
history.description: Our sturgeons are raised in clean, sustainable environments. We believe that exceptional caviar starts with absolute respect for nature and species.

selection.title: The Nine Criteria
selection.description: Colour, grain, texture, firmness and moisture are judged alongside salinity, aroma, maturation and the integrity of each pearl to ensure an unforgettable tasting experience.
